description: Read your workspace's feature contract: which fields of a pricing request, nested metadata included, your buyer-aware pricing models learn from, each named by its path in the API, and the column each one gets in an ONNX export. While one is saved, each logged quote keeps only these labels, never raw metadata. Not available until feature contracts are switched on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential with routing read scope.
name: get_feature_contract
